jannisteunissen/lookup_table_fortran.manifest:
name = "lookup-table-fortran"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "GPL-3.0"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true

scope: Linear lookup tables. An operator-owned FPM manifest wraps the unchanged m_lookup_table.f90 file. The main checks exact interpolation of a linear function, the expected interpolation error for a quadratic, an exact grid value, and clamping below/above the endpoints. No mathematical source edits. The 2D interface, nonuniform spacing options, persistence and all boundary cases are not validated by this example.

source_packaging.note: Only the listed unchanged library files are copied into playground-library; upstream test/program files are excluded.
